stillRetake.V4-057: The guards and soldiers are PERSIAN: soft felt caps, sleeved patterned tunics, trousers, tall wicker shields, bows; no Greek helmets, no crimson cloaks, no round bronze shields. One cloaked civilian led toward the lamplit tent, seen from far behind.
stillRetake.V4-066: No castle, no fortress, no battlements, no towers, no crenellations. The wall is a low rough field wall of unworked limestone blocks about chest height, as a Greek pass wall of 480 BC, with the cliff and the sea beyond; spears and helmets planted around a cold fire; no people.
stillRetake.V4-068: No castle, no fortress, no battlements. The wall behind the men is a low rough field wall of unworked limestone blocks about chest height; the sea and the shore beyond at dawn; the men are hoplites in plain brown cloaks seen from behind with shields down.
stillRetake.V4-078: The figures in the foreground are PERSIAN infantry seen from behind: soft felt caps, sleeved patterned tunics, trousers, tall wicker shields, bows; no Greek helmets, no crimson cloaks, no round bronze shields in the foreground. The ring of bronze shields is far away on top of the low mound.
stillRetake.V4-088: No people and no soldiers anywhere in the frame: only the rocky citadel above the plain at dusk with columns of smoke rising, seen from far across the empty plain.
stillRetake.V4-014: No people, no soldiers, no hoplites anywhere: ONLY the carved stone relief wall of robed Persian figures in procession, close, raking light.
stillRetake.V4-015: No people, no soldiers anywhere: only the ruined columns, carved doorways and stairway of the Persian palace at sunset with the empty plain beyond.
stillRetake.V4-098: No people, no soldiers, no shields anywhere: only the low grassy hill at the foot of the limestone cliffs, wild grass, the plain beyond, low sun.
